english.title: Conspire to manufacture / assemble / procure sale / supply / manufacture of medicinal product for unauthorised sale
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to

(E)_[manufactured]_
(F)_[assembled]_
(G)_[procured the sale of]_
(H)_[procured the supply of]_
(I)_[procured the manufacture of]_
(J)_[procured the assembly of]_

a medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PRODUCT..), knowing or having reasonable cause to believe that it had been or was intended to be sold or supplied contrary to regulation 46(1) of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
